provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

absorbing_exit: Not included as a transient row/column. Row deficits are the rate of absorption. Initial state is entry, and the experiment stops on the first visit to exit.
protocol: Apply each equal-cost upgrade separately to the original process. The unchanged mobile-to-entry rate is1/s and trap-to-mobile rate.01/s. Recompute the mobile diagonal as minus its total outgoing rate, including exit. Mean absorption time t satisfies -Q*t=ones for each transient row generator. Choose the upgrade minimizing the entry-state mean time, tie within1e-10s by lexical ID.
scope: Continuous-time memoryless hopping in a controlled finite transport network with a slow reversible trap. This is a first-passage endpoint, not a stationary population or inverse of a single outgoing rate.
